 replay Replay: Patriots Unfiltered & Patriots Catch-22 Tue Nov 10 - 01:00 PM | Wed Nov 11 - 09:55 AM EXPAND FOR MORE LIVE STREAMS WHAT'S COMING UP NEXT: Wed Nov 11 | 02:20 PM - 02:45 PM live LIVE: Head Coach Mike Vrabel Press Conference, 2:25 PM ET Watch Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel's Wednesday press conference live at 2:25 PM ET. Sun Nov 15 | 07:30 AM - 12:30 PM live LIVE: 98.5 FM In-Game Radio Broadcast Tune-in to the simulcast of the in-game broadcast for the Patriots flagship radio station 98.5 The Sports Hub. Play-by-play broadcaster Bob Socci will call the action along with former Patriots quarterback Scott Zolak, who will provide color analysis during the Patriots game. Please note that the broadcast is open to everyone in the US on a desktop, but is restricted to the Patriots local market on mobile devices. Sun Nov 15 | 08:10 AM - 09:15 AM live LIVE: Patriots Pregame Show: Packers Preview and Team Warm-Ups | 8:15 AM - 9:15 AM ET Watch live as host Jack Webb along with Patriots.com's Paul Perillo, Mike Dussault and Patriots Hall of Famer Troy Brown preview all the action and get the fans' take heading into each game. You'll hear from opponent beat writers and get all the late-breaking news. Send your questions to be answered on air to [podcasts@patriots.com](mailto:podcasts@patriots.com) or call us at 508-298-0398 or toll free at 855-PATS-500. VIEW MORE Patriots Postgame Show 
 Patriots Postgame Show: Breaking Down the Patriots Week 9 Loss to the Packers
 Tune in as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patritos 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers. They glance over the few good takeaways, like DeMario Douglas' week-by-week improvement. They dive into the details of the bad performances from the entire secondary to Drake Maye's relapse into bad decision-making. Plus, they talk about their biggest concerns about this Patriots team going into a tough stretch of games starting in Germany against the Detroit Lions.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 11/8: Breaking Down the Patriots Week 9 Loss to the Packers
 Tune in as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patritos 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers. They glance over the few good takeaways, like DeMario Douglas' week-by-week improvement. They dive into the details of the bad performances from the entire secondary to Drake Maye's relapse into bad decision-making. Plus, they talk about their biggest concerns about this Patriots team going into a tough stretch of games starting in Germany against the Detroit Lions.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 11/1: Breaking Down the Patriots Win Over the Dolphins
 Watch as the Patriots Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots 24-19 victory over the Miami Dolphins. They discuss good takeaways, including Maye's consistency streak, Rhamondre Stevenson's versatility, and more. They talk about inconsistencies in the secondary, offensive line, and other areas that didn't look as good. They broke down the key differences in the first and second half that propelled the Patriots to a win despite being down. Plus, DT Cory Durden calls into the show to discuss recording his first career sack, the defense's key plays, and more!
 NOW PLAYING video Cory Durden Talks Win over the Dolphins on Patriots Postgame Show
 Patriots DT Cory Durden joins the Patriots Postgame show after the team's 24-19 win over the Miami Dolphins. Durden discusses his 1.5-sack game, the defense's key plays, coming together in the second half, and more!
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 10/22: Breaking Down the Patriots 30-24 Loss to the Bears
 Tune in as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots Week 7, 30-24 loss to the Chicago Bears on Thursday Night Football. They go over the good parts of the game, including Maye's 321-yard, 3 TD performance. They highlight the bad, like the high volume of missed tackles, coverage busts, and A.J. Brown's quiet night. Plus, they review injuries, postgame comments, and discuss what the Patriots should focus on heading into their 10-day preparation window before they head back on the road in Week 8.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 10/18: Breaking Down 26-19 Win Over the Jets
 Tune in with the Postgame Crew as they break down the Patriots 26-19 win over the New York Jets in Week 6. They go over their good takeaways, like Drake Maye's decision-making and ball security, and the run game. They discuss the bad performances on both sides of the ball, including an underwhelming return from A.J. Brown, the run defense, and careless fumbles. Plus, they review the slew of injuries and discuss how the team may chart the depth ahead of a quick turnaround against the Chicago Bears.
 NOW PLAYING video Robert Spillane Talks Win Over the Jets on the Patriots Postgame Show
 Watch as Patriots linebacker Robert Spillane joins the Patriots Postgame Show to discuss the 26-19 win over the New York Jets and the defenses performance.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 10/11: Breaking Down the Patriots 45-17 Win Over the Raiders
 Tune in as the Patriots Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots huge 45-17 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 5. They go over the best aspects of the game, including Drake Maye's 399-yard, 5-TD performance. They call out the bad parts of the game like undisciplined flags and Doubs' missed opportunities. Plus, they talk about injuries, offensive scheme, and DeMario Douglas calls into the show to talk about his two-touchdown day, offensive chemistry, and Patriots practice mentality.
 NOW PLAYING video DeMario Douglas Talks Patriots 45-17 Win on Patriots Postgame Show
 Watch as wide receiver DeMario Douglas joins the Patriots Postgame Show to discuss New England's 45-17 win over the Raiders and his two touchdown performance.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 10/4: Breaking Down 29-26 Win Over the Bills
 Tune in as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots win over the Bills on the road! They cover the good, the bad, and the injured, including Drake Maye's confident passing, big WR plays, and more. They discuss what it means to be the first team to beat Buffalo in their new stadium, and how they can build on the clean performance. Plus, Efton Chism III calls in to talk about his game-winning TD, stepping after Mack Hollins went down, and more!
 NOW PLAYING video Efton Chism Joins the Patriots Postgame Show to Discuss Week 4 Win Over the Bills
 Patriots wide receiver Efton Chism calls in to the Patriots Postgame Show to discuss the Week 4 win over the Buffalo Bills and his game winning touchdown catch.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 9/27: Breaking Down the Patriots Week 3 Loss to the Jaguars
 Tune in as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots Week 3, 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars. They break down everything that went wrong in the blowout loss and what the team must focus on to snap the streak of poor offensive production. Plus, they discuss other concerns about injuries and more, as the Patriots must turn the page to Buffalo in Week 4.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 9/20: Breaking Down the Patriots 20-3 Win Over the Steelers
 Tune in as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots 20-3 home opening win over the Pittsburgh Steelers! They dive into the good and bad areas of the Patriots performance, including winning the turnover battle, offensive stalling, and more. They review the multiple injuries that happened and how the Patriots can bounce back and prepare ahead of a tough two-game road trip. Plus, Christian Elliss calls into the postgame show to talk about the win and his 10-tackle performance.
 NOW PLAYING video Christian Elliss Joins the Patriots Postgame Show
 Patriots LB Christian Elliss called in to the Patriots Postgame Show to discuss recording his second-career 10-tackle game against the Steelers, winning the home opener off of a dominant defensive performance, and more!
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 9/9: Patriots at Seahawks Week 1 Breakdown
 Watch as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots' 2026 season opening loss to the Seahawks in Seattle. They go over the good and bad takeaways from the game, including Drake Maye's interceptions, A.J. Brown's injury, the running game, and more. They discuss playcalling on both sides of the ball and address any remaining questions on depth. Plus, they answer fan calls, discuss how the Patriots should move forward, and more!
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 8/27: Patriots vs. Browns Preseason Week 3 Breakdown
 Watch as the Postgame Crew breaks down the Patriots' preseason finale against the Cleveland Browns. They share their takes on the good, bad, and injured from the game, and their biggest takeaways in the context of overall depth and roster cutdown day. Plus, they discuss burning questions about starters, defense, and more as the Patriots look ahead to their Week 1 Super Bowl rematch against the Seahawks.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 8/22: Patriots vs. Eagles Preseason Week 2 Breakdown
 Tune in as the Patriots Postgame crew delivers a full breakdown of the Patriots Preseason Week 2 matchup with the Eagles. They talk about their biggest positive and negative takeaways from the game, additional injuries on the offensive line, and more. They react to Head Coach Mike Vrabel's comments on depth issues and poor defensive play. Plus, WR Kyle Williams calls into the show to talk about his 69-yard touchdown, break down his route running, and the offense's game-winning drive.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 8/13: Full Breakdown of Patriots Preseason Opener Against the Colts
 Tune in as the Patriots Postgame crew shares their observations and analysis from the Patriots 13-13 tie in Week 1 of the NFL preseason. They discuss the good, bad, and injured from the game, including their takes on Andy Borregales' missed field goals, Caleb Lomu's debut, Ben Brown's injury, and more! Plus, they discuss what conclusions can be drawn regarding the Patriots depth chart, and where glaring holes lie on their roster. Plus, they talk about what they'll be looking for as the Patriots host the Philadelphia Eagles for two joint practices ahead of their preseason Week 2 matchup.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 1/25: Full Breakdown of AFC Championship Win Over Broncos
 Tune in as Kwani, Deuce, and Paul break down the Patriots 10-7 win over the Broncos in the AFC Championship. They talk good and bad takeaways, weather conditions in Denver, and more. They discuss the Patriots punching their ticket to the organization's 12th Super Bowl, and the records they set and broke to get there. Plus, cornerback Carlton Davis III joins the show live to discuss winning the AFC Championship, playing through the weather conditions in Denver, and punching their ticket to Santa Clara for the Super Bowl!
 NOW PLAYING video Carlton Davis III Joins the Patriots Postgame Show to Discuss Winning the AFC Championship
 Patriots cornerback Carlton Davis III joined the Patriots Postgame Show to discuss winning the AFC Championship, playing through the weather conditions in Denver, and punching their ticket to Santa Clara for the Super Bowl!
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 1/18: Full Breakdown of Divisional Round Win Over Texans
 Tune in as we break down the Patriots thrilling 28-16 win over the Houston Texans to advance to the AFC Championship. They discuss their good and bad takeaways from the game, including their defensively dominant performance, Kayson Boutte's one-handed game-winning TD, the offensive line, and more. They are joined by Matt Smith as he clues us in on what Vrabel, Maye, and other players had to say postgame. Plus, Boutte calls in live to walk through his one-handed snag, earning an AFC Championship appearance and more!
 NOW PLAYING video Robert Spillane Discusses Win Over the Texans on Patriots Postgame Show 1/18
 Watch as Patriots linebacker Robert Spillane joins the Patriots Postgame Show to discuss the 28-16 win over the Houston Texans in the AFC Divisional Playoffs and advancing to the AFC Championship Game.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 1/11: Full Breakdown of Wild Card Win Over Chargers
 Tune-in as we breakdown the Patriots 16-3 win over the Chargers to advance to the Divisional Round of the playoffs. We discuss the highlight of the night's rock fight in Zak Kuhr's play-calling and the defense's suffocating execution. We also dive into other elements like Drake Maye's TD dime to Hunter Henry, offensive line performance, and the run game. Plus, LB K'Lavon Chaisson calls in to talk the defense's performance, red zone stops, and more!
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 1/4: Full Breakdown of Win Over Dolphins
 Tune-in as we breakdown the Patriots 38-10 win over the Dolphins to close out the regular season at 14-3. We talk about the standout performance from Rhamondre Stevenson, the defense's rally after a poor start, and more! Matt Smith tunes us in to coach and player post game press conferences. Plus, we think ahead with the Patriots upcoming playoff game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
 NOW PLAYING video Rhamondre Stevenson Joins Patriots Postgame Show to Discuss Win and 3 TD Performance vs. Miami Dolphins
 Watch as Patriots running back Rhamondre Stevenson joins the 'Patriots Postgame Show' to discuss the 38-10 win over the Dolphins and his 3 touchdown performance.
 NOW PLAYING video Patriots Postgame Show 12/28: Full Breakdown of Win Over Jets
 Tune-in as we break down the Patriots' dominant 42-10 win over the New York Jets to secure a perfect 8-0 road record! We discuss the good and bad takeaways including Drake Maye and the offense's production, run defense, and more! We discuss the win's potential to crown New England AFC East Champions pending a Bills loss. Plus, we talk the playoff picture as the Patriots look to close out the regular season against the Dolphins at Gillette Stadium.

 In episode 4 of Forged in Foxborough presented by New Balance, you'll get an exclusive look at the 2026 New England Patriots with in-depth behind-the-scenes access as the team goes through the first several weeks of the 2026 NFL Season. See how the Patriots responded to the challenges of early adversity, as well as celebrating the Super Bowl XXXVI team that started the Patriots Dynasty 25 years ago.
